text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
And here I thought it was a good idea~...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, morning, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Ahaha, it's nothing~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, I've got preparations for the Fan Thanksgiving Festival after this.
I might be a little late to training, okay? See ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The paper she left behind catches my eye.
It looks like the layout map for the Fan Appreciation Festival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like a proposal to rearrange the layout and decorate each area, but...
I haven't heard anything about the plan being approved.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's true. Copano Rickey did mention
something about rearranging the venue.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I cannot possibly approve this. Rearranging the entire venue
based on feng shui, of all things..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's certainly an outrageous scale.
Still, she likely proposed it with the intent
to channel good energy throughout the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She always senses others' troubles, shows concern,
and gives her all to bring them happiness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She only ever wanted to make someone happy.
If she's wearing such a sad expression—
choice_data_list: (I want to do something for her...!)
(I want to do something to help her...!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
How flexible are we with reassignments,
you ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We've already submitted the instruction sheets to the contractor
...so unfortunately, I think it would be difficult...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look back over the notebook where I wrote down
all the Feng Shui tips Copano Rickey taught me.
choice_data_list: I wonder if there's a clue in here somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are the lights still on
in Trainer's room?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: They're working so hard... Oh, I know☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Pardon me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, because Trainer's working so hard!
I came to clean up and put out some houseplants!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Cleaning is the foundation of feng shui, but properly decorating will bring even more luck☆ And that'll make you happy too, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: (She must be feeling down deep inside, though...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Suddenly, looking at her, inspiration strikes.
Cleaning and decorating. If I base everything around
these two fundamentals of feng shui...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ho, I see.
Just 'cleaning and decorating the gate', is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "In feng shui, the entryway holds great significance... In that case, if we can align the festival's main gate according to feng shui..."
choice_data_list: Her wish is sure to come true

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Very well, I have accepted it.
...As long as it stays within reason,
adding a bit of flair is more than welcome.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Really, Trainer? Really-really?
You got permission to decorate the gate?
choice_data_list: It might not be enough for the original plan, though...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it, um... Things like this
don't happen often, so I was surprised...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Th-That's kind of ticklish! Like you've seen right through me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sensing someone's worries and solving them.
I think I was able to do it because I watched it happen right by my side.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
N-No way~...!
I just wanted everyone's worries to go away
and for them to be happy~!
choice_data_list: Then I'll make Rickey happy myself.
Then I'll make Rickey happy myself.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh?
Hold on a second.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...It feels nice, doesn't it?
Having someone do things for you..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Ummm.
Well, hehe...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Aah!
I'm gonna go grab some tea!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...All right!
Let's do our best and decorate the gate!
choice_data_list: It's for the kids who come to visit, too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...Even more than usual,
extra special happiness!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...Umm, oh, right!
What were we talking about again?"
choice_data_list: Are we talking about doing our best to decorate the gate, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahh, right...
...I might not be feeling up to it today...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Um, hey?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Are you doing that unconsciously, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Trainer, that thing you have...
...Never mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After that, she fell completely silent.
Alongside a wordlessly following Copano Rickey,
we focused diligently on decorating the gate..."
